what_changed: Fixed a silent total-failure in `dispatch_subagent` (`scripts/orchestrator_runner.py`) where every subagent call was returning `None` because the orchestrator used the legacy `claude agent <name> --input <json>` CLI form, which does not exist in Claude Code v2.x. The corrected invocation is `claude --setting-sources project,local -p <framed-prompt> --agent <name> --plugin-dir ... --allowedTools ...`. Six new unit tests in `tests/orchestrator/test_dispatch_subagent.py` lock in the updated argv shape, the execution-framing contract, and all four failure-mode branches (missing binary, non-zero exit, empty stdout, unparseable JSON). No behavior was changed beyond the argv fix; error handling is identical to before.
why: Claude Code v2.x removed the positional `agent <name>` subcommand and the `--input` flag. Every production dispatch was returning a non-zero exit code, causing `dispatch_subagent` to return `None` silently and marking the entire pipeline run as failed while exiting 0 — a deceptively clean failure that obscured all downstream subagent output. CCE-2 tracks this as the root-cause fix for the v2.x CLI surface mismatch.
notes: Live Mode B smoke test against ADIS was deferred (requires plugin install or --plugin-dir wiring); tracked as a follow-up in CCE-2. The `--setting-sources project,local` flag added in this PR (CCE-15 hardening) is bundled into the same argv change and should be noted in any CLI-surface reference page.
